newsitem.title: USA: Worthington sees Q1 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Worthington sees Q1 profits up.

text.p: Worthington Industries Inc's first-quarter profits were markedly higher than last year's $0.24 a share, a senior company official said on Tuesday.

Edward A. Ferkang, Worthington's group vice president for processed steel, told investors that profits in the quarter just ended were "up significantly over last year" and the company saw a 20 percent increase in sales for all of fiscal 1997. Sales totaled $1.48 billion in the year ended May 31. The first quarter ended August 31.

When asked about future capital spending, chief executive John P. McConnell declined to project future outlays. However, told the Salomon Brothers' investors conference that the company would be "very comfortable taking (debt) up to 50 percent" of capitalization from the current 30 percent range to fund outlays.
